note: Exploratory challenger fixed in prereg/ML_PLAN.md before any ML run. Not part of F1 or F2. Actuals are latest revised data, not first releases.

band.method: rolling quantiles of the model's errors public by the origin, last 156 weeks

winner.rule: ml or blend replaces the best of ar, c0 and c1 only if its dev MAE at h=4 is at least 2% lower (prereg/ML_PLAN.md)

order_value: A 1 NOK/kg difference on a 10-tonne order is 10,000 NOK of gross purchase value (a purchase scenario, not a trade).
